sql: WITH f AS (SELECT r.lead_id, min(r.sent_at) AS first_sent FROM lead_reactivation_history r WHERE r.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND r.status IN ('sent','replied') AND r.sent_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.lead_id) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_leads WHERE status = 'fechado') AS fechados_total, (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_leads WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL) AS fechados_com_data, (SELECT count(*) FROM f JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = f.lead_id WHERE l.closed_at >= f.first_sent) AS castelo_fechados_depois_reativacao, (SELECT count(*) FROM f JOIN campaign_leads l ON l.id = f.lead_id WHERE l.status = 'fechado') AS castelo_reativados_fechados_hoje, (SELECT eve_reminder_enabled::text || ' / ' || eve_reminder_hour::text FROM visit_confirmation_settings WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') AS vespera, (SELECT party_soon_alert::text FROM ai_agent_settings WHERE company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001') AS festa_proxima
